question.question: Does a zero-initialised branch that adds per-graph max, min and std of the final node states to the mean-pooled embedding improve the unchanged post-BN K1 at fixed 100K?
question.deficiency: Mean pooling keeps only first-moment information of the final node states; no K1 endpoint has tested extremal or spread statistics beside the mean. Frozen-state probes bound the usable signal at about 1.25 meV, so the prior is low.
alternatives: Final node states carry no extremal signal beyond the mean
Train-versus-development gap rather than readout information limits accuracy
Gains below the 3 meV gate are seed variation
The branch stays near zero and is unused
question.positive_decision: Nominate only for independently authorized seed replication and a 500K transfer question after complete paired acceptance
question.negative_decision: Close the K1 extremal and second-order readout family without adoption, retry or scale-up

profile.hardware: Tesla T4x2 FP32, one arm per device
